name: mothership
description: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Mothership LTL, FTL & Local Freight.

interface.longDescription: Mothership is a freight shipping platform for LTL, truckload, and local freight. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your Mothership account, so you can quote, book, and track shipments in plain language. Compare carrier rates and delivery dates, book the one you want, and check where your shipments are. You can also cancel a shipment, find a freight class, check whether Mothership serves an address, and review your billing. Anything that costs money waits for your confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Get a freight quote for 2 pallets from Reno, NV to Phoenix, AZ
Which Mothership account am I connected as?

publication.release_notes: Connects to the Mothership MCP server at mcp.mothership.com. Get freight rates with quote-create, then book one with shipment-create, which shows a checkout card and books only after you confirm. Track a shipment with shipment-get, and find shipments with shipment-search and shipment-list. Cancel a shipment with shipment-cancel after it shows the fee and refund. Look up NMFC items and freight classes with nmfc-search, nmfc-get and freight-class-calculate, check service areas and address types with location-search, and review rebills and invoices.
